Amid escalating backlash, the company are looking at Argentina’s Patagonia as a potential destination for large-scale data centers, as per Reuters.
Currently, the data center market is relatively small in Argentina and concentrated in Buenos Aires.
The investors look to capitalize on the region’s cool climate, renewable energy resources, shale gas reserves and vast undeveloped land.
Argentina’s improved economic outlook under President Javier Milei and the RIGI incentive regime are attracting data center investment.
Investors are also watching the 2027 election and Milei’s proposed Super RIGI framework, which could offer larger tax cuts.
